name: Northwood Golf Club
architects: Alister MacKenzie with Robert Hunter (1928), for the Bohemian Club; conceived by Jack Neville

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 1246462624) bbox 621 x 429 m (E 500191-500812, N 4258697-4259126) + scenery, 4 x 3 chunks of 256 m: west edge 32 m east of E 500000 (the edge of the 3DEP DEM tile and lidar tiles fetched; s00 reads the world + 32 m), about 160 m west, 245 m east, 170 m north and south

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project CA_NorthernCA_B22 (tile x50y426, published 2026-03-24), cut to the world + 100 m (the tile's west edge is E 499994, so 6 m on that side) by pipeline/intake.py raster; EPSG:26910 (NAD83 / UTM 10N), metres; fetched through the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-northwood)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project CA_NorthernCA_B22 (flown 2022-23; files dated 2024-02-13), tiles 10SEH0058, 10SEH0059 and 10SEH0159 (the east edge), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation is not classified in this project; classes present 1, 2, 7, 9, 18, 20); NAD83(2011) / UTM 10N, NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres; fetched through the GitHub workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-northwood; rockyweb.usgs.gov). 10SEH0158 (x 501000-502000, y < 4259000: the world's south-east 56 x 472 m, river and hillside) was refused (HTTP 429): no trees there.
laz.label: 2022 USGS lidar (Northern California B22)

scorecard_source: Third-party, unverified (no official card reachable): GreensKeeper.org scorecard page and golfingrecord.com, which agree (White 2,893, the total golf.com, GolfLink and GolfNow give), read 2026-11-12. GolfPass (course 2688) differs on White holes 1, 2, 4, 5 and 9 (2,888); Red (2,506) and Gold (1,983) agree everywhere. Ratings are the 18-hole figures (White 67.8/114, Red 69.0/121, Gold 60.0/100, GreensKeeper); GolfPass gives the nine as 33.9/114. Stroke index: the 9-hole SI of golfingrecord. Built: White, the longest set (4.1). Not built: Red, Gold.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): the longest tee set as the default, all water red, OB = the course boundary, trees from lidar with fairway trees removed, wind 1-7 mph (a sheltered river valley in the redwoods). Theme `redwoods`, new for this course (developer's request, 2026-11-12).
tee_shot_note: tee_shot_margin_m: the tee-shot tree check (pipeline/tee_shots.py) keeps the ball 0.5 m clear of each crown; without it the check passed hole 3 while the game's ball clipped a redwood crown 48 m out (course chat, 2026-11-13; as at Stone Creek)
max_tree_note: Coast redwoods: 18 lidar crowns are 65-74 m tall (checks.json max_tree_h_m 80); second-growth redwoods in the lower Russian River reach about 75 m

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-11-13 (standing default: tee-shot blockers removed): a 53 m redwood clump (lidar crown radius 16 m, likely two crowns merged) whose crown hangs over the 3rd's tee shot 48 m out; s06b's lowest-shot check misses it, the game's 8-iron clips it
